; pinnedPageSleepScreen v0.16.2
; Pin a specific document page as the sleep screen shown by the sleep window — and,
; via the native "Visible content" toggle, keep the CURRENT screen on the sleep screen:
; the Navigator snapshots the framebuffer at the instant a sleep begins (its state-change
; handler runs before the sleep window renders), and freeze mode displays that shot.
; (A transparent sleep window does NOT retain: the app UI beneath is torn down at deep
; entry, leaving plain white — verified on device.)
;
; Sleep-screen matrix (pinned x Settings.lightSleepEnabled), per-sleep entry origin
; (button = displayState 0->2, idle = 1->2, recorded to power.json by the Navigator):
;   unpinned + off : stock wallpaper everywhere
;   unpinned + on  : current screen everywhere (freeze)
;   pinned   + off : pinned page everywhere
;   pinned   + on  : button -> pinned page, idle -> current screen (asymmetric)
;
; Requires: rm-shot, framebuffer-spy, xovi-message-broker, qt-resource-rebuilder
; State:    /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json
;             v2: {docId, pageId, pageIdx, ts, chapters:[{file, chrome:[{x,y,w,h}], transform, ts}]}
; Images:   /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/ch0.png (chrome-free) .. ch3.png (rotating)
;           + legacy pinned.png (pin-time blind capture; shown only when no chapters)
;
; Toolbar-less display (docs/toolbarless-design.md): every capture records which screen
; rects were covered by chrome ("chapter"); the sleep window stacks chapter images
; oldest->newest, each painted with holes at its own chrome rects, so every pixel shows
; the newest chrome-free content. ch0 is captured with ALL chrome hidden: DocumentView's
; Item#_uiContainer contains the toolbar and every overlay (incl. other mods' floating
; bars), so one replaced binding blanks them all; the hold engages only while chrome is
; not painted yet (pin-flow / cold open / wake), so it never flashes.
;
; All insertions are wrapped in id'd child objects: other mods (linkFromSelection,
; createDocumentFromPages, floating) patch the same roots, so root-level attached
; handlers (Component.onCompleted etc.) would collide and break QML compilation.
; Root-level property/function/signal inserts are fine (floating.qmd does the same).

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/PagesMoreFoldout.qml
	TRAVERSE FoldoutOverlay#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			signal pinSleepClicked
			property string pinSleepLabel: qsTr("Set as sleep screen")
			property bool pinSleepVisible: true
		}

		TRAVERSE ColumnLayout
			LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.FoldoutItem#addAfterItem
			INSERT {
				ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
					id: pinSleepItem
					objectName: "pinSleepItem"
					visible: root.pinSleepVisible
					Layout.fillWidth: true
					label: root.pinSleepLabel
					// ark's Icon resolves iconSource itself (own SVG loader + colorizer). It
					// opens the value as a QFile: bare path works, "file://" URL does NOT
					// (renders blank). Plain QML Image is the opposite — don't mix them up.
					iconSource: "/home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pinnedSleepScreen.svg"
					onClicked: root.pinSleepClicked()
				}
			}
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Navigator (always alive, even on the home screen): records every display power
; transition + the Visible content toggle into power.json, and — when the toggle
; is on — grabs the framebuffer at the moment a sleep begins. This handler runs
; synchronously on the state change, BEFORE the sleep window renders and flushes,
; so a 0-delay shot captures the screen as the user last saw it. (Retention via a
; transparent sleep window does NOT work for deep sleep: the app UI beneath is
; torn down at entry and the composited frame is plain white — verified on
; device. Only the light-sleep banner benefits from a frozen screen.)
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: pinSleepPower
				visible: false

				XoviMessageBroker {
					id: pinSleepPowerBroker
				}

				function write(prev, next) {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/power.json");
					xhr.send(JSON.stringify({
						"prev": prev, "next": next, "ts": Date.now(),
						"lightSleepEnabled": Settings.lightSleepEnabled === true
					}));
				}

				Connections {
					target: BatteryManager
					ignoreUnknownSignals: true
					function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
						pinSleepPower.write(previous, next);
						// awake -> any sleep: snapshot the screen the user just left.
						// For idle (0->1) the screen then freezes, so the shot stays
						// representative through the whole light phase and into deep.
						if (previous === 0 && next !== 0
								&& Settings.lightSleepEnabled === true) {
							pinSleepPowerBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot",
								"/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/current.png,0");
						}
					}
				}

				Component.onCompleted: pinSleepPower.write(-1, BatteryManager.displayState)
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; The toggle's stock description only mentions standby — with this mod it also
; controls the sleep screen, so say so.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/DisplayVisibleContent.qml
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		REPLACE description WITH {
			description: qsTr("Show your open document or overview when in standby and on the sleep screen.")
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Toolbar root: the shared "bus" both DocumentView and DeviceSceneView can reach
; (DeviceSceneView has `required property Item toolbar`). Holds the chrome-hide
; switch, the chrome-rect query hook (assigned by DocumentView, which can also see
; other mods' floating bars), and the toolbar's own painted rects — the inner ids
; (strip/handle/close) are only resolvable from inside Toolbar.qml.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			property bool pinSleepChromeHold: false
			property var pinSleepChromeQuery: null

			function pinSleepOwnRects() {
				var out = [];
				if (!root.visible) return out;
				var items = root.expanded ? [toolbar, closeButton] : [hideShowButton];
				for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
					var it = items[i];
					if (!it || !it.visible || it.width <= 0 || it.height <= 0) continue;
					var p = it.mapToItem(root, 0, 0);
					out.push({ "x": Math.floor(p.x), "y": Math.floor(p.y),
						"w": Math.ceil(it.width), "h": Math.ceil(it.height) });
				}
				return out;
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DocumentView: Item#_uiContainer holds ALL chrome (Toolbar, battery/page/title
; labels, notification bar, zoom button, floating.qmd's panels) while sceneView is
; a sibling outside it — one binding blanks every overlay at once. Never touch
; toolbar.visible itself: it carries a 9-clause stock binding.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE BEFORE Item#_uiContainer
		INSERT {
			property alias pinSleepChromeHold: toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold

			Item {
				id: pinSleepChrome
				visible: false

				function push(out, item) {
					if (!item || !item.visible || item.width <= 0 || item.height <= 0) return;
					var p = item.mapToItem(root, 0, 0);
					out.push({ "x": Math.floor(p.x), "y": Math.floor(p.y),
						"w": Math.ceil(item.width), "h": Math.ceil(item.height) });
				}

				function query() {
					var out = [];
					try { if (toolbar.visible) out = toolbar.pinSleepOwnRects(); } catch (e) { }
					// floating-toolbar mod panels; the ids only exist while floating.qmd
					// is applied, so probe them instead of referencing them directly
					try { if (typeof floatQuick !== "undefined") pinSleepChrome.push(out, floatQuick); } catch (e) { }
					try { if (typeof layers !== "undefined") pinSleepChrome.push(out, layers); } catch (e) { }
					return out;
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					if (toolbar.pinSleepChromeQuery === null)
						toolbar.pinSleepChromeQuery = pinSleepChrome.query;
				}
			}
		}

		TRAVERSE Item#_uiContainer
			REPLACE visible WITH {
				visible: !Experimental.pdfPrototype.enabled && !toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold
			}
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/PagesActions.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	TRAVERSE Item#pageActions
		LOCATE BEFORE Connections[.target=document]
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: pinSleepCtl
				visible: false

				readonly property string imagePath: "/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.png"
				readonly property string statePath: "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json"

				property string docId: ""
				property string pageId: ""
				property int pageIdx: -1

				XoviMessageBroker {
					id: pinSleepCtlBroker
				}

				function load() {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						try {
							var j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
							pinSleepCtl.docId = j.docId || "";
							pinSleepCtl.pageId = j.pageId || "";
							pinSleepCtl.pageIdx = (j.pageIdx !== undefined) ? j.pageIdx : -1;
						} catch (e) {
							pinSleepCtl.docId = "";
							pinSleepCtl.pageId = "";
							pinSleepCtl.pageIdx = -1;
						}
					};
					xhr.open("GET", pinSleepCtl.statePath);
					xhr.send();
				}

				function save(obj) {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.open("PUT", pinSleepCtl.statePath);
					xhr.send(JSON.stringify(obj));
				}

				function toggle() {
					if (pageSelection.isEmpty || pageSelection.pages.length !== 1) return;
					var idx = pageSelection.pages[0];
					var pid = "";
					try { pid = document.idForPage(idx); } catch (e) { }
					if (!pid) return;

					var unpin = (document.id === pinSleepCtl.docId && pid === pinSleepCtl.pageId);

					// chrome-hold: chrome is hidden right now (pages overview covers it) and
					// navigation to the pinned page is coming — keep it hidden until the
					// clean chapter-0 capture lands. DeviceSceneView releases it (20s cap).
					if (!unpin) {
						try {
							if (typeof pageActions.documentView.pinSleepChromeHold === "boolean"
									&& pageActions.documentView.currentPage !== idx) {
								pageActions.documentView.pinSleepChromeHold = true;
							}
						} catch (e) { }
					}

					pageSelection.clear();
					internal.moreButtonState = PagesActions.MoreButtonState.Default;

					if (unpin) {
						pinSleepCtl.docId = ""; pinSleepCtl.pageId = ""; pinSleepCtl.pageIdx = -1;
						pinSleepCtl.save({});
						notificationQueue.enqueue({
							"text": qsTr("Removed from sleep screen"),
							"style": Notification.Secondary
						});
					} else {
						pinSleepCtl.docId = document.id; pinSleepCtl.pageId = pid; pinSleepCtl.pageIdx = idx;
						pinSleepCtl.save({ "docId": document.id, "pageId": pid, "pageIdx": idx });
						notificationQueue.enqueue({
							"text": qsTr("Page set as sleep screen"),
							"style": Notification.Secondary
						});
						// jump to the page so the capture shows it, not this menu
						Qt.callLater(function() {
							try {
								pageActions.documentView.openPage(idx, DocumentView.ScrollPosition.Restore);
							} catch (e) {
								pageActions.requestPage.page = idx;
								pageActions.requestPage.trigger();
							}
							pinSleepCtlBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot",
								pinSleepCtl.imagePath + ",2000");
						});
					}
				}

				Component.onCompleted: pinSleepCtl.load()
			}
		}

		TRAVERSE Component#moreFoldout
			TRAVERSE PagesMoreFoldout
				LOCATE AFTER ALL
				INSERT {
					pinSleepVisible: !pageSelection.isEmpty && pageSelection.pages.length === 1
					pinSleepLabel: (!pageSelection.isEmpty
							&& pageSelection.pages.length === 1
							&& document.id === pinSleepCtl.docId
							&& pageSelection.pages[0] === pinSleepCtl.pageIdx)
						? qsTr("Remove from sleep screen")
						: qsTr("Set as sleep screen")
					onPinSleepClicked: {
						pinSleepCtl.toggle();
					}
				}
			END TRAVERSE
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: pinSleepWatch
				visible: false

				readonly property string dirPath: "/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/"

				property string docId: ""
				property string pageId: ""
				property int pageIdx: -1
				property var chapters: []
				property bool pinActive: docId !== ""
					&& root.document
					&& root.document.id === docId
					&& root.document.idForPage(root.page) === pageId

				// hold state lives on the toolbar bus so PagesActions can pre-engage it
				readonly property bool chromeHeld: root.toolbar
					? root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold === true : false

				XoviMessageBroker {
					id: pinSleepBroker
				}

				function beginHold() {
					if (root.toolbar && typeof root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold === "boolean")
						root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold = true;
				}

				function releaseHold() {
					pinSleepHoldRelease.stop();
					if (root.toolbar && root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold === true)
						root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold = false;
				}

				function reload() {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						try {
							var j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
							pinSleepWatch.docId = j.docId || "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageId = j.pageId || "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageIdx = (j.pageIdx !== undefined) ? j.pageIdx : -1;
							pinSleepWatch.chapters = (j.chapters && j.chapters.length) ? j.chapters : [];
						} catch (e) {
							pinSleepWatch.docId = "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageId = "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageIdx = -1;
							pinSleepWatch.chapters = [];
						}
						// hold hygiene once pinActive is current: drop a hold that landed on
						// the wrong page; engage one when the pinned page is entered while
						// chrome hasn't painted yet (cold open / pin-flow) — that is the
						// flash-free window for the clean chapter-0 capture.
						if (pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld && !pinSleepWatch.pinActive) {
							pinSleepWatch.releaseHold();
						} else if (pinSleepWatch.pinActive && !pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld
								&& root.toolbar && root.toolbar.visible === false) {
							pinSleepWatch.beginHold();
						}
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file://" + pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				function save() {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.open("PUT", "file://" + pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.json");
					xhr.send(JSON.stringify({
						"docId": pinSleepWatch.docId,
						"pageId": pinSleepWatch.pageId,
						"pageIdx": pinSleepWatch.pageIdx,
						"ts": Date.now(),
						"chapters": pinSleepWatch.chapters
					}));
				}

				function tfNow() {
					var r = root.pageBorderRect;
					return { "x": Math.round(r.x), "y": Math.round(r.y),
						"w": Math.round(r.width), "h": Math.round(r.height) };
				}

				function tfEq(a, b) {
					return a && b
						&& Math.abs(a.x - b.x) <= 2 && Math.abs(a.y - b.y) <= 2
						&& Math.abs(a.w - b.w) <= 2 && Math.abs(a.h - b.h) <= 2;
				}

				function chromeNow() {
					if (pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld) return [];
					var t = root.toolbar;
					if (t && t.pinSleepChromeQuery) {
						try { return t.pinSleepChromeQuery(); } catch (e) { }
					}
					return null;
				}

				// Unpinning happens in the pages overview with NO page/document change,
				// so pinActive can be stale here — and since capture() writes docId back
				// to pinned.json, a stale capture RESURRECTS the pin (and its image
				// becomes whatever was on screen). Re-validate against the file before
				// every shot; if the pin is gone, adopt that and stand down.
				function capture(delayMs) {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						var j = null;
						try { j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); } catch (e) { }
						if (!j || !j.docId || !j.pageId) {
							pinSleepWatch.docId = "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageId = "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageIdx = -1;
							pinSleepWatch.chapters = [];
							pinSleepWatch.releaseHold();
							return;
						}
						pinSleepWatch.docId = j.docId;
						pinSleepWatch.pageId = j.pageId;
						pinSleepWatch.pageIdx = (j.pageIdx !== undefined) ? j.pageIdx : -1;
						pinSleepWatch.chapters = (j.chapters && j.chapters.length) ? j.chapters : [];
						if (!pinSleepWatch.pinActive) {
							pinSleepWatch.releaseHold();
							return;
						}
						pinSleepWatch.captureNow(delayMs);
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file://" + pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				// One capture = one chapter update: the current chrome rects + page
				// transform decide whether it overwrites the head chapter (same chrome
				// layout: plain stroke update) or starts a new one (layout changed).
				// A transform change (scroll/zoom/other page) invalidates older chapters:
				// their pixels no longer align. An empty rect list means the screen is
				// chrome-free — that capture supersedes everything as the new ch0.
				function captureNow(delayMs) {
					var rects = chromeNow();
					if (rects === null) {
						// metadata plumbing unavailable — plain v0.10 behavior
						pinSleepBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot",
							pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.png," + delayMs);
						return;
					}
					var tf = pinSleepWatch.tfNow();
					var kept = [];
					for (var i = 0; i < pinSleepWatch.chapters.length; i++) {
						if (pinSleepWatch.tfEq(pinSleepWatch.chapters[i].transform, tf))
							kept.push(pinSleepWatch.chapters[i]);
					}
					var file;
					if (rects.length === 0) {
						kept = [{ "file": "ch0.png", "chrome": [], "transform": tf, "ts": Date.now() }];
						file = "ch0.png";
					} else {
						var head = kept.length ? kept[kept.length - 1] : null;
						if (head && head.file !== "ch0.png"
								&& JSON.stringify(head.chrome) === JSON.stringify(rects)) {
							head.ts = Date.now();
							file = head.file;
						} else {
							var others = [];
							for (var k = 0; k < kept.length; k++)
								if (kept[k].file !== "ch0.png") others.push(kept[k]);
							if (others.length >= 3)
								kept.splice(kept.indexOf(others[0]), 1);
							var used = {};
							for (k = 0; k < kept.length; k++) used[kept[k].file] = true;
							file = !used["ch1.png"] ? "ch1.png"
								: (!used["ch2.png"] ? "ch2.png" : "ch3.png");
							kept.push({ "file": file, "chrome": rects, "transform": tf, "ts": Date.now() });
						}
					}
					pinSleepWatch.chapters = kept;
					pinSleepWatch.save();
					console.log("pinSleep: capture -> " + file
						+ " rects=" + rects.length + " chapters=" + kept.length
						+ (pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld ? " (held)" : ""));
					pinSleepBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot",
						pinSleepWatch.dirPath + file + "," + delayMs);
					if (pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld) {
						pinSleepHoldRelease.interval = delayMs + 400;
						pinSleepHoldRelease.restart();
					}
				}

				// Never capture a page whose tiles aren't rendered yet: on a cold open
				// (or right after an xochitl restart) the page is blank for a while and
				// we would overwrite a good image with an empty one. isLoading also stays
				// true the whole time another view (pages overview) sits on top, and it
				// flickers with controller.working on every stroke — so deferred captures
				// are released by POLLING for a settled not-loading state, never by
				// reacting to isLoadingChanged edges (v0.9 did, and released mid-transition).
				function tryCapture(delayMs) {
					if (!pinSleepWatch.pinActive) return;
					// Light sleep (the native "current screen" idle mode) freezes the
					// screen but keeps the CPU — and our timers — running. The fb then
					// holds the retained page WITH the sleep banner composited on top,
					// and inSuspend hides the toolbar so it even masquerades as a clean
					// ch0. Never capture while the display sleeps; wake re-arms us.
					if (BatteryManager.displaySleeping) return;
					// isLoading ignores pendingTiles DURING a gesture, so gate on the
					// gesture states explicitly or a capture can fire mid-pinch
					if (root.isLoading || root.gesturing || root.movingWithScrollbar) {
						pinSleepPendingChecker.ticks = 0;
						pinSleepPendingChecker.restart();
						return;
					}
					pinSleepWatch.capture(delayMs);
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepPendingChecker
					interval: 300
					repeat: true
					property int ticks: 0
					onTriggered: {
						ticks++;
						if (!pinSleepWatch.pinActive || ticks > 50) { // give up after ~15s
							stop();
							return;
						}
						if (BatteryManager.displaySleeping) {
							stop(); // wake re-arms; a sleep-time release would grab the banner
							return;
						}
						if (!root.isLoading && !root.gesturing && !root.movingWithScrollbar) {
							stop();
							pinSleepWatch.capture(200);
						}
					}
				}

				// safety: a hold may never leave the user chrome-less for long
				Timer {
					id: pinSleepHoldCap
					interval: 20000
					running: pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld
					onTriggered: pinSleepWatch.releaseHold()
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepHoldRelease
					interval: 600
					onTriggered: pinSleepWatch.releaseHold()
				}

				function arm() {
					pinSleepSettleTimer.restart();
					pinSleepLateTimer.restart();
				}

				onPinActiveChanged: {
					if (pinActive) arm();
				}

				// Zoom/scroll: you can't write mid-gesture, and the whole screen is
				// repainting anyway — so hide chrome for the ride (no distinct blink)
				// and land a fresh clean ch0 once the new transform settles. The old
				// book is dropped by the transform check in capture(). If the hold's
				// 20s cap fires during a marathon pan, the settle capture degrades to
				// a normal chaptered one.
				function onTransformGesture(active) {
					if (active) {
						if (pinSleepWatch.pinActive) pinSleepWatch.beginHold();
					} else if (pinSleepWatch.pinActive) {
						pinSleepWatch.arm();
					}
				}

				Connections {
					target: root
					function onPageChanged() {
						pinSleepWatch.reload();
						pinSleepWatch.arm();
					}
					function onDocumentChanged() {
						pinSleepWatch.reload();
						pinSleepWatch.arm();
					}
					function onPenCloseChanged() {
						if (!root.penClose && pinSleepWatch.pinActive) pinSleepStrokeTimer.restart();
					}
					function onGesturingChanged() {
						pinSleepWatch.onTransformGesture(root.gesturing);
					}
					function onMovingWithScrollbarChanged() {
						pinSleepWatch.onTransformGesture(root.movingWithScrollbar);
					}
					function onPageBorderRectChanged() {
						if (pinSleepWatch.pinActive) pinSleepTransformTimer.restart();
					}
				}

				// Central transform watcher: catches every scroll/zoom path (one-finger
				// swipe scroll, zoom reset button, ...) that the gesture hooks above
				// don't see. Fires once the rect stops moving; if the settled transform
				// differs from the head chapter's, the old book is stale — hold chrome
				// and land a fresh clean ch0 (chrome blinks off/on once, after the
				// scroll, which is the accepted cost outside a gesture repaint).
				Timer {
					id: pinSleepTransformTimer
					interval: 600
					onTriggered: {
						if (!pinSleepWatch.pinActive) return;
						if (root.gesturing || root.movingWithScrollbar) return; // gesture path owns it
						var tf = pinSleepWatch.tfNow();
						var head = pinSleepWatch.chapters.length
							? pinSleepWatch.chapters[pinSleepWatch.chapters.length - 1] : null;
						if (head && pinSleepWatch.tfEq(head.transform, tf)) return; // no real change
						pinSleepWatch.beginHold();
						pinSleepWatch.arm();
					}
				}

				// Wake-up capture: if the device slept while the pinned page was still
				// rendering (or mid-write), the stored image is stale/broken — re-arm on
				// any display state change so a fresh gated capture runs after resume.
				// Timers are frozen during suspend, so arming on the way INTO sleep is
				// harmless: they fire after wake. While suspended the toolbar is invisible
				// (its stock binding has !inSuspend), so this is also a flash-free window
				// to hold chrome and refresh the clean ch0 right after wake.
				Connections {
					target: BatteryManager
					ignoreUnknownSignals: true
					function onDisplayStateChanged() {
						if (!pinSleepWatch.pinActive) return;
						if (!pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld
								&& root.toolbar && root.toolbar.visible === false)
							pinSleepWatch.beginHold();
						pinSleepWatch.arm();
					}
				}

				// escape hatch: closing/collapsing the toolbar fires a capture, so
				// "hide toolbar, then sleep" refreshes the head chapter with less chrome.
				// Skipped during a hold: hiding the container flips shown/expanded too.
				Connections {
					target: root.toolbar ? root.toolbar : null
					ignoreUnknownSignals: true
					function onShownChanged() {
						if (root.toolbar && !root.toolbar.shown
								&& pinSleepWatch.pinActive && !pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld)
							pinSleepToolbarTimer.restart();
					}
					function onExpandedChanged() {
						if (root.toolbar && !root.toolbar.expanded
								&& pinSleepWatch.pinActive && !pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld)
							pinSleepToolbarTimer.restart();
					}
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepToolbarTimer
					interval: 600
					onTriggered: pinSleepWatch.tryCapture(0)
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					pinSleepWatch.reload();
					pinSleepWatch.arm();
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepSettleTimer
					interval: 800
					onTriggered: pinSleepWatch.tryCapture(200)
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepLateTimer
					interval: 5000
					onTriggered: pinSleepWatch.tryCapture(0)
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepStrokeTimer
					interval: 250
					onTriggered: pinSleepWatch.tryCapture(0)
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepRefreshTimer
					interval: 30000
					repeat: true
					running: pinSleepWatch.pinActive && !BatteryManager.displaySleeping
					onTriggered: pinSleepWatch.tryCapture(0)
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/sleepscreen/qml/default/sleep-window-opaque.qml
	IMPORT device.ui.text 1.0
	IMPORT common 1.0
	TRAVERSE BaseView#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			property string pinSleepPath: ""
			property var pinSleepModel: []
			property string pinSleepProbeSrc: ""
			// freeze = paint NOTHING but the pill; the e-paper then retains whatever
			// is on screen ("current screen" sleep, no capture involved)
			property bool pinSleepFreeze: false

			Item {
				id: pinSleepGate
				visible: false

				property int retries: 0

				// (full screen minus rects) as a list of band rects — the "holes" each
				// chapter layer leaves open so older, chrome-free pixels show through
				function complement(rects, W, H) {
					if (!rects || rects.length === 0)
						return [{ "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": W, "h": H }];
					var ys = [0, H];
					var i, j;
					for (i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
						ys.push(Math.max(0, Math.min(H, rects[i].y)));
						ys.push(Math.max(0, Math.min(H, rects[i].y + rects[i].h)));
					}
					ys.sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
					var out = [];
					for (i = 0; i + 1 < ys.length; i++) {
						var y0 = ys[i], y1 = ys[i + 1];
						if (y1 <= y0) continue;
						var iv = [];
						for (j = 0; j < rects.length; j++) {
							var r = rects[j];
							if (r.y < y1 && r.y + r.h > y0)
								iv.push([Math.max(0, r.x), Math.min(W, r.x + r.w)]);
						}
						iv.sort(function(a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; });
						var x = 0;
						for (j = 0; j < iv.length; j++) {
							if (iv[j][0] > x)
								out.push({ "x": x, "y": y0, "w": iv[j][0] - x, "h": y1 - y0 });
							x = Math.max(x, iv[j][1]);
						}
						if (x < W)
							out.push({ "x": x, "y": y0, "w": W - x, "h": y1 - y0 });
					}
					return out;
				}

				// NEVER blank the pin state up front: an intermediate "nothing pinned"
				// frame exposes the stock logo (whose path is invalid here -> error
				// placeholder), and on idle sleep that frame gets flushed to the EPD as
				// a white "reMarkable is sleeping" flash. State is only swapped once
				// the fresh json is in hand, and only if it actually changed — an
				// unchanged model keeps its delegates (and decoded images) alive.
				// Freeze decision, per sleep: the Visible content toggle must be on,
				// and either nothing is pinned (current screen everywhere) or the
				// sleep came in through light sleep (idle -> current, button -> pin).
				// Freeze shows current.png — the entry-instant framebuffer shot the
				// Navigator took — through the same full-bleed logo path as legacy,
				// including its decode-error retry (the shot may still be writing).
				function decide(pinned) {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						var on = false, fromLight = false;
						try {
							var p = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
							on = p.lightSleepEnabled === true;
							fromLight = (p.prev === 1 && p.next === 2);
						} catch (e) { }
						root.pinSleepFreeze = on && (!pinned || fromLight);
						if (root.pinSleepFreeze) {
							root.pinSleepPath = "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/current.png?v=" + Date.now();
						}
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/power.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				function check() {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						var j = null;
						try { j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); } catch (e) { }
						pinSleepGate.decide(!!(j && j.docId));
						if (!j || !j.docId) { // unpinned (or unreadable state)
							root.pinSleepPath = "";
							root.pinSleepModel = [];
							root.pinSleepProbeSrc = "";
							return;
						}
						if (j.chapters && j.chapters.length) {
							var W = root.width > 0 ? root.width : 954;
							var H = root.height > 0 ? root.height : 1696;
							var m = [];
							for (var i = 0; i < j.chapters.length; i++) {
								// query string is a cache-buster only (dropped by the
								// file engine); retries forces a re-decode after a
								// partial rm-shot write
								var src = "file://" + "/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/"
									+ j.chapters[i].file
									+ "?v=" + (j.chapters[i].ts || 0) + "." + pinSleepGate.retries;
								var free = pinSleepGate.complement(j.chapters[i].chrome, W, H);
								for (var k = 0; k < free.length; k++) {
									m.push({ "src": src, "cx": free[k].x, "cy": free[k].y,
										"cw": free[k].w, "ch": free[k].h });
								}
							}
							if (JSON.stringify(m) !== JSON.stringify(root.pinSleepModel)) {
								root.pinSleepModel = m;
								root.pinSleepProbeSrc = m.length ? m[m.length - 1].src : "";
							}
							root.pinSleepPath = "";
						} else {
							// v1 state: single blind capture from pin time; the nonce
							// forces a re-read of the file (same string = no reload)
							root.pinSleepModel = [];
							root.pinSleepProbeSrc = "";
							root.pinSleepPath = "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.png?v=" + Date.now();
						}
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				Component.onCompleted: pinSleepGate.check()

				Connections {
					target: root
					function onVisibleChanged() {
						if (root.visible) {
							pinSleepGate.retries = 0;
							pinSleepGate.check();
							// power.json is written by the Navigator on the same state
							// change that shows this window — the first read can race it
							// and see the PREVIOUS sleep's origin. Re-decide once settled.
							pinSleepRecheck.restart();
						}
					}
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepRecheck
					interval: 600
					onTriggered: pinSleepGate.check()
				}

				// If sleep was pressed while rm-shot was still writing, the newest image
				// decodes as garbage and the window would show a broken screen for the
				// whole nap. Retry while the newest layer is in Error: check() rebuilds
				// with a fresh cache-buster once the file is complete.
				Timer {
					interval: 500
					repeat: true
					running: root.visible
						&& root.pinSleepPath !== ""
						&& logo.status === Image.Error
						&& pinSleepGate.retries < 6
					onTriggered: {
						pinSleepGate.retries++;
						pinSleepGate.check();
					}
				}

				Timer {
					interval: 500
					repeat: true
					running: root.visible
						&& root.pinSleepModel.length > 0
						&& pinSleepProbe.status === Image.Error
						&& pinSleepGate.retries < 6
					onTriggered: {
						pinSleepGate.retries++;
						pinSleepGate.check();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		REBUILD makeSleepScreenPath
			LOCATE BEFORE STREAM \ return \
			INSERT {
				if (root.pinSleepPath !== "") {
					path = root.pinSleepPath;
				}
			}
		END REBUILD

		TRAVERSE ?#logo
			LOCATE BEFORE ALL
			INSERT {
				cache: false
			}
			REBUILD width
				LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { root.pinSleepPath !== "" ? parent.width : }
			END REBUILD
			REBUILD height
				LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { root.pinSleepPath !== "" ? parent.height : }
			END REBUILD
		END TRAVERSE

		TRAVERSE ?#illustration
			REBUILD visible
				LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { !root.pinSleepFreeze && root.pinSleepPath === "" && root.pinSleepModel.length === 0 && }
			END REBUILD
		END TRAVERSE

		; the stock logo's path is invalid when the carousel is active, so this white
		; "reMarkable is sleeping" sheet is permanently "visible" underneath our layers
		; in chapters mode — keep it out entirely so no decode gap can ever expose it
		TRAVERSE ?#errorPlaceholder
			REBUILD visible
				LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { root.pinSleepModel.length === 0 && }
			END REBUILD
		END TRAVERSE

		TRAVERSE InputBlocker:contentItem
			LOCATE AFTER ALL
			INSERT {
				Item {
					id: pinSleepLayerHost
					anchors.fill: parent
					visible: root.pinSleepModel.length > 0 && !root.pinSleepFreeze

					Repeater {
						model: root.pinSleepModel
						delegate: Item {
							clip: true
							x: modelData.cx
							y: modelData.cy
							width: modelData.cw
							height: modelData.ch
							Image {
								x: -modelData.cx
								y: -modelData.cy
								width: pinSleepLayerHost.width
								height: pinSleepLayerHost.height
								source: modelData.src
							}
						}
					}

					Image {
						id: pinSleepProbe
						visible: false
						width: 1
						height: 1
						source: root.pinSleepProbeSrc
					}
				}

				Rectangle {
					id: pinSleepIndicator
					visible: root.pinSleepFreeze || root.pinSleepPath !== "" || root.pinSleepModel.length > 0
					color: "white"
					border.color: "black"
					border.width: 1
					width: pinSleepIndicatorText.width + 16
					height: pinSleepIndicatorText.height + 8
					radius: 4
					anchors {
						right: parent.right
						rightMargin: 20
						top: parent.top
						topMargin: 15
					}
					Text {
						id: pinSleepIndicatorText
						font.pixelSize: Values.fontSizeBody1
						font.bold: true
						text: qsTr("Sleeping")
						anchors.centerIn: parent
					}
				}
			}
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
